name: technical
text: A mixture of experts model chooses a small set of neural networks for each token. The router assigns probabilities, and the selected experts transform the hidden state. Their outputs are multiplied by routing weights and added together. During inference, some experts receive many tokens while others receive only one. A useful experiment records these counts, checks numerical accuracy, and compares complete execution time under the same conditions. Faster isolated kernels do not always produce a faster application.

name: narrative
text: Mira arrived at the station before sunrise. The platform was quiet except for a porter moving a cart of parcels. She opened her notebook and checked the address again. Beyond the tracks, a bakery had just switched on its lights. The first train was delayed, so she bought a warm roll and watched the town wake up. When the announcement finally came, she folded the paper map and walked toward the waiting carriage.

name: structured
text: Experiment checklist: one, choose a baseline; two, fix the input dimensions; three, record the software versions; four, validate the output; five, warm up the implementation; six, measure repeated invocations; seven, retain raw samples; eight, repeat with independent seeds. Report median latency in milliseconds and identify whether dispatch is included. Compare uniform, balanced, and skewed routing. Record hardware limitations and avoid generalizing from one device to all accelerators.
